doc.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012

title: Not a composer, and dropping out of music school
summary: He says he writes tunes but never studied composition and left music school after a week to avoid Korea.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Let’s suppose I represented a patron of the arts, like the old days, and I offered you a commission to write a piano concerto.

I mean I write some tunes. But I never studied composition and I never studied counterpoint. I went to music school but it was trying to get out of the Korean War, and I lasted a week in music school and I dropped out. But I didn’t want to go over to Korea. And it was just ending right about that time. And I’m not a violent person. I don’t think I’ve ever hurt anybody intentionally. I’m only trying to bring joy to people.
